findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "company_officers" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_url, email_check, rss_read, read_spreadsheet, pdf_to_text, wayback, seo_audit · Private data: make_docx, make_csv, domain_check, police_neighbourhood, make_xlsx, boe_series · Public sink: email_check, package_info · Destructive: format_money, iban_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_url, email_check, rss_read, read_spreadsheet, pdf_to_text, wayback, seo_audit · Private data: make_docx, make_csv, domain_check, police_neighbourhood, make_xlsx, boe_series · Public sink: email_check, package_info · Destructive: format_money, iban_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
